title: The CI step of the clean-room sequence cites docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md, the name ADR-035 gives the document

context.task: Rename, in the name of the CI step that runs the clean-room sequence and in the test that pins that name, the document it cites: docs/design/PRUEBA_EN_LIMPIO.md becomes docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md (ADR-035). Nothing else changes.

select.heading: ADR-035 — File names in English; the register keeps the decisions a reader needs, unedited (2026-10-19, author)

problem: ADR-035 gives every file that stays in the published tree an English name; docs/design/PRUEBA_EN_LIMPIO.md becomes docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md. The CI step that runs the clean-room sequence is named "Clean-room sequence (docs/design/PRUEBA_EN_LIMPIO.md, section 4)" in .github/workflows/ci.yml, and tests/unit/test_ci_workflow.py pins that name in CLEAN_ROOM_NAME. The executing agent renames the document after this delegation, in the same batch; the step's name must cite the new path, and the test must pin it.
decisions: D1 In tests/unit/test_ci_workflow.py, the value of CLEAN_ROOM_NAME becomes exactly "Clean-room sequence (docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md, section 4)". Nothing else in the test file changes: no test is added, removed or renamed.
D2 In .github/workflows/ci.yml, the name of that step becomes exactly the same string. Nothing else in the workflow changes: the header, the other steps and every run line stay byte for byte.
D3 The section number stays: section 4 of the renamed document keeps the sequence.

D4 tests/unit/test_ci_workflow.py is governed (tests/**): its edit goes through validate_proposal, with a Rationale, even if the schema of validate_proposal shown to you lacks that field. .github/ is not governed: edit the workflow with Edit, without a receipt.
D5 Order: the test first, seen red for its stated reason (the workflow still names the step with the old path); then the workflow.
D6 The test does not check that the cited document exists, and none is added: the document is renamed by the executing agent after this commit.
D7 No new dependency and no file outside files_may_touch: in particular not docs/, README.md, CLAUDE.md or opencode.jsonc, which the executing agent changes after the merge.

D8 Gates: red-first, the changed test seen failing for its stated reason before the workflow changes; full-suite, pytest tests exits 0 at the commit; verify-red-green, tools/audit/verify_red_green.py exits 0 on the report.

behaviours.statement: The CI step that runs the clean-room sequence is named "Clean-room sequence (docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md, section 4)", and tests/unit/test_ci_workflow.py pins that name.
Everything else the workflow tests pin holds as today: the header, the two pinned actions, the pinned installs, the clean-room tests and the full suite.

tests.must_catch: a clean-room step whose name still cites docs/design/PRUEBA_EN_LIMPIO.md, or any name other than the decided one
tests.reason: at base the workflow names the step with the old path, so the test that pins the new name fails

tests.must_catch: a change to the header, the actions, the installs or the run lines of the workflow
tests.reason: the other three tests of tests/unit/test_ci_workflow.py hold at base and must keep holding, unchanged

commit_message: ci: the clean-room step cites docs/design/CLEAN_ROOM.md (ADR-035)
